'''Sian Tesar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], she was stationed aboard the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']].
